simple.summary: תֵּל חַרְשָׁא (Têl Charshâʼ) means Tel-Charsha , a place in Babylonia First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 59.

definitions.full: H8521. Tel Charsha חַרְשָׁא תֵּל proper name, of a location in Babylonia ; — Ezra 2:59 = Neh 7:16 ; Θααρησα , ( Θελ ) αρησα , etc., ᵐ5 L Ezra Θαλαα καὶ Πησα .
definitions.rootNote: from 8510 and the feminine of 2798 ; mound of workmanship ;
